label: Žázrivský korbáčik
note: Protected local variety (PGI) of korbáčik from the Žázrivá area in Orava; the generic korbáčik is made in many places.

about.text: Žázrivský korbáčik is a korbáčik that may be made only in the village of Žázrivá in northern Slovakia. Soured cow milk cheese is steamed, pulled by hand into strands and plaited into the shape of a whip. It is a protected geographical indication product.
